sent.meta_tools: The request carries the search and load meta-tools; the model finds a tool before it calls it.

presentation.limit: A belt of up to {limit} tools is sent in full.

tools.title: Per-tool decision rules
tools.empty: The belt is empty: the model is shown no tool.

cannotSee.empty: Every tool in the registry is on the belt.

enrollment.lead: The hosts enrolled under this agent's key, and what each one's daemon last reported.

empty.title: No host is enrolled under this agent

incidents.empty: No incident is recorded on this agent's hosts.

none.title: No definition committed
none.body: The definition of record is the file .oxagen/agents/{slug}.toml in the workspace repository. Write it in the source editor; saving commits it to a branch and opens a pull request.

definition.unparsed: The committed file does not parse at line {line}. Open it in the source editor to read and fix it.

source.title: Source
source.lead: Every field is a view of this commit. The running definition is what the default branch holds; this commit runs once its pull request merges.

rotate.title: Rotate the credential of {name}
rotate.body: The current key is refused at its next presentation and a new one is issued. The new secret is shown once.
rotate.done: The new credential, shown once. Store it now:

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.body: A suspended agent anchors no governed run and is shown an empty belt. Its credentials, roles and hosts stay as they are.

resume.title: Resume {name}
resume.body: The agent anchors governed runs again, with the credentials, roles and hosts it held.

retire.title: Deregister {name}
retire.body: The principal is retired, never deleted, so its runs keep their identity. Every credential and host enrollment is revoked. Removing the definition file is a pull request.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your organization role does not allow this change. Nothing was changed.
failure.noPrincipal: The request carried no signed-in user. Sign in and try again.
failure.delegationCeiling: The file names tools you do not hold, so you cannot grant them to the agent. Nothing was committed.
failure.agentRetired: This agent is retired. Nothing was changed.
failure.agentPrincipalMissing: This agent has no delegated principal. Nothing was changed.
failure.noRepository: This workspace has no repository bound. Bind a repository to the workspace, then commit.
failure.repositoryAmbiguous: This workspace binds more than one repository, so the commit has no single target. Nothing was committed.
failure.branchIsDefault: That branch is the repository's default branch. Choose another branch.
failure.definitionSchema: The file's schema line is missing or names another schema. Nothing was committed.
failure.definitionSlug: The file's slug does not match this agent's slug. Nothing was committed.
failure.timeZoneUnavailable: Your time zone could not be read, and the days you picked mean different instants in each zone. No mandate was requested. Try again.
failure.timeZoneUnsupported: Your saved time zone is not one this server can read, so the days you picked cannot be placed in it. No mandate was requested. Pick a time zone again in your account settings.
failure.refused: The change was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: The request was refused as invalid. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: The change is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The change could not be made: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.noToolMatches: No declared tool with a consequence tag matches those patterns in this workspace, so the mandate would cover nothing.
failure.measureNotDeclared: A tool version those patterns match declares no such measure, so the limit could not be read from a call. A financial tool whose schema does not expose an amount cannot be given a mandate.
failure.measureUnitMismatch: A covered tool declares that measure in a different unit. The gate reads a call in the unit the tool declares, so a limit denominated in anything else would be enforced as a figure nobody entered. Name the unit the tool declares.
failure.measureKindConflict: Two tools your patterns cover declare that measure differently — one as an amount, one as a count — so there is no single figure to enforce. Narrow the patterns so they cover tools that agree on what the measure counts.

source.lead: Every field on the Definition tab is a view of this file. Saving commits it to a branch and opens a pull request; the default branch is never written.

parse.error: The file does not parse at line {line}: {reason}.

reason.array_separator: array items need a comma between them
reason.inline_table_key: an inline table entry needs a key
reason.inline_table_separator: inline table entries need a comma between them
reason.unreadable_value: a value is not a string, number, boolean, array or table
reason.expected_key_value: a line must be key = value, a [table] header or a comment
reason.text_after_value: there is text after the value

commit.title: Commit {path}

commit.branchHint: Created from the default branch when new; a branch with an open pull request gets this commit on it.
commit.messageHint: The commit and pull request title. Optional.
commit.submit: Commit and open a pull request

invalid.message: The message is at most 200 characters.

mandates.title: Mandates recorded
mandates.lead: A mandate is bounded, expiring authority for the consequences it names. Nothing in a role, a grant or a toolbelt substitutes for one.
mandates.none: No mandate is recorded for this agent — none granted, and none requested — so it cannot carry a consequence.
mandates.noneDetail: A call that carries a consequence tag is denied before dispatch — before any credential is minted and before anything reaches a tool server — whether or not the tool is on this agent's belt.
mandates.authority: Remaining authority is what the ledger says: every draw reserves, then settles against a receipt or releases. The tools a mandate covers appear on the belt gated by mandate and approval, never as plainly allowed.

request.title: Request a mandate
request.body: The request is recorded as a draft for the role accountable for this consequence to grant or decline. A draft grants nothing.
request.measureHint: The name the tool version declares the figure under, which is how it is read from a call. It cannot be “calls”: every call draws one of those, and the field below sets that limit. Leave the measure fields blank to limit calls alone — the only limit a tool that declares no measure can carry.
request.perPeriodHint: Name a per-call limit, a per-period limit, or both.
request.toolsHint: Patterns over slug@version, separated by commas. Everything else is denied.
request.purposeHint: Written for the office that reads the ledger.
request.validToHint: A mandate expires. There is no unbounded option.
request.unitHint: What the measure counts, in the name the tool version declares — rows, recipients, GB. It must be the declared unit: the gate reads a call in that unit, so a limit denominated in another is enforced as a figure nobody entered, and the request is refused. Not a currency code: a limit in money is scaled by the tool’s declaration, which nothing here can read, so it is asked for over the API or MCP instead.
request.perCallHint: Whole units of the measure. The figure is recorded exactly as typed and is never scaled, so the limit this request carries is the figure entered.
request.consequenceTagsHint: Name every consequence the covered tools declare. A mandate covers a tool only when it names all of them — name one of a tool’s two and the mandate is granted as asked and the call is still denied. The six above are the starter set; a workspace defines its own, and those go in the field beneath.
request.consequenceOther: Others the tools declare, separated by commas

mandates.truncated: The newest {shown} mandates recorded for this agent. There are at least that many, and older ones are not listed here.
mandates.noneEffective: No mandate recorded for this agent is in effect, so it cannot carry a consequence. The rows below are a request awaiting a decision, or history.
mandates.partial: You see the mandates of the agents you created. This list is not every mandate recorded for this agent.
mandates.noneListed: No mandate listed here is in effect. The list above is not complete, so that is not a statement that the agent holds no authority.
mandates.noneListedDetail: An org Owner, Admin, Billing or Compliance reader sees every mandate recorded in the workspace. Ask one of them whether this agent holds authority, or read the Tools ledger with that role.
mandates.retired: This agent is retired, so it cannot be given a mandate: its principal is suspended and authority granted now could never be drawn. The mandates recorded for it stay listed.
mandates.noneEffectiveUpcoming: No mandate recorded for this agent is in effect yet, so it cannot carry a consequence. A mandate granted below has not reached the date it starts on; any others are a request awaiting a decision, or history.
